C-GRAPH-COVERAGE.Summary: Close the three-layer graph coverage defect: describe undescribed surfaces, govern every non-test src/ file with MODULE_CONTRACT LINKS (full reverse edge), and add a lint check that active plans' GraphAnchors own module-ownable ObservedWriteScope paths via those LINKS.
C-GRAPH-COVERAGE.Problem:
Recorded three times as deferred debt (A36.4, A46.6, A52.3) and never scheduled. Stage-1 re-derivation at 170a0c5 confirmed three layers; A53 accepted stage 1 and blocked A/C as proposed (corrections 141–143).
Layer 1 — coverage. GD-MAIN had 12 modules / 11 Path files against 56 non-test src/ files. Undescribed: src/gates, src/review, src/verification, src/query (corr 140: query was never in the debt notes).
Layer 2 — linkage. Governed files: 0; eleven graph.module-without-linked-files warnings. No production MODULE_CONTRACT; Linked Files in context --task always "none" (A46.4).
Layer 3 — consistency. No check joins GraphAnchors to ObservedWriteScope. C-REVIEW-SURFACE writes src/review/* while anchoring modules that do not own those paths.
A53.1 / 141: Path + co-located surface left ten src/ files unowned (CLI verbs, language-registry, test-support), including src/grace-context.ts from C-SELECTION. A53.2 / 142: directory-prefix ownership is not a partition and lets layer 3 pass without MODULE_CONTRACT. A53.3: full coverage is +179 MODULE_MAP lines over the middle rule, exact parity on all 56 files, and the only option that dissolves 141 and 142. A53.4 / 143: this bundle's own plan is the live subject.

Goals.Goal: Layer 1: graph + verification describe gates, review, localization, query, context, and test-support surfaces within the 50-anchor / 30 KB budgets.

Layer 2: every non-test file under src/ is governed with honest ROLE/MAP_MODE and MODULE_CONTRACT LINKS to exactly one primary module (partition). Every Path-bearing module has ≥1 linked file. Root lint has zero graph.module-without-linked-files.

Layer 3: lint errors when an active plan's module-ownable OWS path (non-test under src/) does not declare LINKS to any of that plan's GraphAnchors. No directory-prefix ownership. Archived plans are not evaluated. Non-src and test paths never alone trip the rule.
This bundle's active plan.xml passes the layer-3 rule under a real ngrace lint invocation (A53.4). context --task shows non-empty Linked Files for linked modules.

Constraints.Constraint: plan.xml before production code (A17.3). Spec and plan approved via ngrace gate approve before implementation commits that change product behavior.
Own bundle, own PR. Do not fold C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS. Do not touch phase board rows. Archive immutable.
D14: layer-3 code is lint (change.* or scope.*), never gate.* or review.*.
Do not retire graph.module-without-linked-files by removing Path. Linkage becomes true.
ROLE honest: SCRIPT/LOCALS for zero-export entry (src/grace.ts); never CONFIG as map escape. Exact export parity on all governed .ts (zero production export *).
Layer-3 ownership is LINKS-only (clause 2). No directory-prefix clause (corr 142).
Standing rule 11: every Linked Files line and the new error message must read true aloud.
Surgical diffs. No new runtime dependencies. Skill mirrors byte-identical if skills change.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Rewriting archived plans to pass layer 3. They remain historical; D16 witness may use fixture copies of their bodies in tests, not archive edits.
C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS (packed modules, review --base, archive plan resolve for review).
Promoting graph.module-without-linked-files from warning to error in this bundle.
Changing selection algorithm beyond data it already projects.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER1-MODULES-PRESENT: .ngrace/graph/main.xml declares modules for gates, review, localization (verification), query, context, and test-support with Path on real production files; matching V-M-* exist. Discriminating negative: removing any of those modules leaves its Path file without a home module or reintroduces an undescribed surface for plans that must anchor it.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER2-FULL-SRC: Every non-test file under src/ is governed (hasGraceMarkers / MODULE_CONTRACT). Governed files count equals the non-test src/ population (56 at implementation baseline). Each file LINKS exactly one primary module that exists in the graph. Discriminating negatives: an ungoverned non-test src/ file remains after the change; a file with LINKS to a missing module emits markup.unknown-link.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER2-REVERSE-EDGE: bun run ngrace lint --path . reports zero graph.module-without-linked-files. Every module that declares Path has ≥1 governed LINKS. Discriminating negative: stripping LINKS from M-CLI's Path file reintroduces the warning for M-CLI.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER2-HONEST-ROLES: No newly governed production file uses ROLE: CONFIG unless it is genuinely configuration. src/grace.ts uses SCRIPT/LOCALS (zero exports). Discriminating negative: CONFIG on src/review/core.ts or RUNTIME/EXPORTS on src/grace.ts fails parity or review.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER3-LINT-CHECK: lint emits change.graph-anchors-miss-write-scope (error) when an active plan lists a non-test src/ path in ObservedWriteScope whose MODULE_CONTRACT LINKS intersects none of the plan's GraphAnchors (or the file is not governed). Ownership is LINKS only — not Path prefix. Discriminating negatives (A7.2, one axis each): (1) anchors own scope via LINKS → silent; (2) anchors do not → red; (3) OWS only non-src paths → silent; (4) same mismatch under archive/ → not evaluated / no issue from this code. Message names the path and that LINKS must include a GraphAnchors module.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER3-SELF-APPLICATION: This bundle's active plan.xml GraphAnchors and ObservedWriteScope satisfy the layer-3 rule under bun run ngrace lint --path . after implementation. Discriminating negative: root lint emits change.graph-anchors-miss-write-scope for C-GRAPH-COVERAGE (A53.4).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER3-ARCHIVE-POLICY: Archived plans are not rewritten and root lint does not fail solely because archive content would fail layer 3. Discriminating negative: evaluating archive plans for this code turns the clean tree red.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CONTEXT-LINKED-FILES: ngrace context --task for a plan anchoring a linked module prints Linked Files with real paths, not "- none". Discriminating negative: Linked Files — none for a module with Path and governed LINKS.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-BUDGETS-HOLD: GD-MAIN and VD-MAIN stay under 50 anchors and 30 KB. Discriminating negative: graph.document-too-large or anchor-limit warning from this bundle's graph edits.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS-SCOPE: Diff does not implement C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS items. Discriminating negative: packed-files, review --base, or archive review resolve land in this change's production diff.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Root: 0 errors, 0 graph.module-without-linked-files, Governed files = non-test src/ count, C-GRAPH-COVERAGE silent for change.graph-anchors-miss-write-scope. Fixture suite: both directions on layer-3 axes. context --task non-empty Linked Files. validate:ci green. D14: no gate.* / review.* from runLint.

Assumptions.Assumption: DECISION A (ratified round 2): full coverage — every non-test file under src/ is governed. Path-only and Path+co-located leave unowned files (141) or require prefix ownership (142). Full coverage is +179 MODULE_MAP lines over middle rule; exact parity prevents silent rot.

DECISION B (ratified stage 1 / A53): four surface modules at gates/core, review/core, verification/localize, query/core. Round 2 adds M-CONTEXT (grace-context.ts) and M-TEST-SUPPORT (fixtures.ts) so CLI selection and test helpers have honest module cards (rule 11) rather than overloading M-CLI.

DECISION C (ratified round 2): layer-3 ownership is LINKS-only (clause 2). No directory prefix. Severity error on active plans. Non-src and test paths exempt. Message states the path lacks LINKS into GraphAnchors.
DECISION D (ratified stage 1 / A53): archived bundles not required to pass; not rewritten; not evaluated for the new code.
